title: Introduce cost-bucketed performance profiles and changelog scorer
author: Aisha Rana
release_notes: Added cost_bucketed performance profiles, changelog impact scorer, schema migration and backfill; no breaking changes to API; rollout: gradual, feature-flagged.
description: Motivation: Model performance profiles currently capture latency and throughput but lack explicit cost buckets which makes it hard to predict unit economics for variant rollouts. This PR introduces a cost_bucket field on performance profiles and a changelog scorer that annotates release notes with estimated cost/latency impact and priority. Summary of changes: 1) schema/model: add cost_bucket enum (low|medium|high) and cost_estimate_usd_per_1k_tokens string, plus migration script to add default buckets for existing profiles. 2) API: add optional cost_bucket and cost_estimate fields to the profile upload endpoint; validation and backwards-compatible defaulting to 'medium' when absent. 3) Backfill: job and script to infer buckets from historic telemetry, with confidence scores persisted to profile.metadata.cost_inference. 4) Changelog scorer: service that runs on release drafts to produce a single-line score and a short blurb used in release notes; scoring considers delta in average tokens, batch efficiency, quantization flags and inferred cost buckets. 5) UI: compact badge and tooltip on the model page showing cost bucket and scorer blurb; feature-flagged behind 'cost-profiles-ui'. 6) Tests: unit tests for migration, API validation, scorer heuristics and end-to-end integration tests for backfill. Commits: - add schema change and migration script - wire cost fields into profile ingestion API - implement telemetry-driven backfill and confidence store - implement changelog scorer service and lightweight scorer API - add UI badge and integration tests - docs: add developer-facing doc with scoring rules and examples Files changed (high level): schema/profile.proto updated, services/profile/ingest.go, tools/backfill/infer_cost_bucket.py, services/changelog/scorer/service.py, ui/model_page/badge.tsx, docs/dev/cost-profiles.md, tests/{profile_migration_test.go, scorer_test.py, e2e_cost_profile.test.ts} Review thread: Miguel: "How do we avoid noisy changes for older profiles with sparse telemetry?" Author: "Backfill writes inferred bucket with a confidence tag and we surface low-confidence as 'inferred (low confidence)' in UI; API retains original behavior unless explicit cost_bucket provided." Priya: "Sanity-check on scorer — can we include tokenization differences across runtimes?" Author: "Scorer normalizes by model family and uses seq-length distributions from recent telemetry; added a test vector to cover this." Liam: "Need a rollback plan if backfill behaves poorly." Author: "Backfill is staged and feature-flagged; we also include a revertable DB migration and a compensating job to clear inferred fields." CI summary: all checks passed on latest run including unit, integration, linter and contract tests; codecov decreased by 0.2% due to new scorer service but within allowed threshold. Rollout & merge: feature-flagged rollout; migration runs in background and is reversible; merged via squash on 2024-05-29 after approvals from reviewers. Notes for release: enable 'cost-profiles-ui' behind a gradual rollout; run backfill on non-peak hours and monitor delta signals and API error rates for 48 hours. Links: Linear ENG-6732 for work tracking, docs at docs/dev/cost-profiles.md, brief on scoring heuristics included in PR.
